ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $PA$ and $PB$ are tangent to the circle $\odot O$ at points $A$ and $B$ respectively. Point $C$ lies on circle $\odot O$, and lines $AC$ and $BC$ are connected. If $\angle ACB=60^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle P$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Connect OA, OB,\\
since $\angle ACB=60^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle AOB=2\angle ACB =120^\circ$,\\
also since PA and PB are tangent to the circle O at points A and B respectively,\\
thus $\angle PAO=\angle PBO=90^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle P=360^\circ-\angle PAO-\angle PBO-\angle AOB=\boxed{60^\circ}$.
